test_model_initialization: test model initialization by verifying parameters are properly initialized with zero or one values
test_attention_outputs: test attention outputs by verifying attention tensor shapes and ordering across model layers
test_torchscript_compatibility: test torchscript compatibility by tracing, saving, and loading model modules
test_head_pruning: test head pruning by pruning attention heads and verifying output tensor shapes change correctly
test_resize_tokens_embeddings: test resizing token embeddings by increasing and decreasing vocab size while preserving embedding values
